price_signal: Proefles €67,50; losse les €70/uur; 10 rijlessen €675 (€67,50/les); Pakket B 30 lessen incl. RiS-toets + praktijkexamen €2482 (€65/les)
notes: Specialist in driving lessons for learners with autism/ADHD and rijangst (driving anxiety / faalangst); also offers CBR rijgeschiktheidstests for elderly/disabled. Uses Rijopleiding in Stappen (RiS) method. BOVAG member (V.O.F.). Ownership officially transferred in 2026 from founder Jan Cools to daughter Annemarie Cools (kliknieuwsdenbosch.nl); Jan still gives refresher lessons. Google rating 4.0/5 (9 reviews); Klantenvertellen shows a separate, higher score of 9.4/10 over 177 reviews (21 in last 12 months, 100% recommend). One negative Google review mentions feeling pushed to take >=45 lessons before exam. KvK number on rijschoolspecialist listed as 890329180000 (8-digit KvK 89032918 + vestigingsnummer suffix). No evidence of English-language instruction found on website or aggregators; all reviews are in Dutch.
